logistics.format: Up to 90 questions (multiple-choice and performance-based). Pearson VUE.

plus.note: Project+ is a non-expiring credential, unlike most CompTIA certs.

minus.note: Generalist project-management cert; security relevance is incidental.
PMI PMP / CAPM dominate the PM credential market and are weighted higher.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 2, foundational: 1. The ordered median is associate. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded one-year project-management baseline and Japanese availability support associate coordination skills; incidental security coverage and a multiple-choice-heavy exam do not establish security-program ownership.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: The one-year profile and project-management coverage support associate coordination skills, with some performance questions. Its incidental security content and weaker PM hiring recognition limit its usefulness for security delivery leadership.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded vendor-neutral project-management baseline can help organize security work. Its multiple-choice-heavy format and incidental security relevance support foundational supporting knowledge rather than a professional security rank.
